g.text: FINEXFLY ARCHITECTURE & DATA FLOW CONTROL LAYER
DETERMINISTIC FINANCIAL CALCULATIONS + GROUNDED AI EXPLANATIONS
Equities, mutual funds, gold, fixed deposits
Scoped to user_id = auth.uid() · Server-only service-role access
Strict tenant boundaries · Personal accounts isolated from enterprise organization ledgers
Dual balance sheets, net worth tracking
Two-way gateway vs bank ledger verification
Flags MDR fee variances, duplicates & deposits
Dispatches deterministic tools with verified outputs
Explains verified calculation outputs in plain context
Strict reference to pre-computed metrics only
Trace ID, timestamp, intent, tools used & formulas
Inspectable reasoning pipeline for judges & operators
Auditable decision trace · Grounded explanation only
Initial Cash: ₹4,50,000 · Net Inflow: +₹85,000/mo (₹1,80,000 In − ₹95,000 Out)
Preserves accounting identity: Cash_n = Cash_n-1 + (Revenue_n − Expenses_n)
Proposed scenario variable imports, exception reviews, or ledger updates are staged
No autonomous state mutations or live funds movement
Requires explicit human click authorization ('Apply Variable' / 'Confirm Action')
Auditable trail · Complete operator sovereignty over execution
DATA Source telemetry · ENGINE Deterministic math · AI Routing & explanation · TRACE Auditable reasoning · ACTION Human authorization
Tri-Mode Architecture: REAL (Authenticated Supabase RLS) · DEMO (Synthetic Benchmark) · EMPTY (Honest ₹0 Baseline)
